remarks: Luxurious 2-Bedroom, 2-Bath Condo with Spectacular Views of Long Island Sound  Experience elevated living in this stunning 10th-floor condo, offering breathtaking panoramic views of Long Island Sound from every window. This exquisite residence is perfectly situated to showcase the beauty of all four seasons, with particularly enchanting vistas of New England foliage in the fall. Celebrate the 4th of July with unobstructed views of the fireworks from the comfort of your own balcony.  Inside, you'll find modern elegance with recently renovated bathrooms and kitchen, designed with contemporary finishes and top-of-the-line appliances. The condo features four ample closets, providing abundant storage space.  Located just a 10-minute walk from beautiful Stamford downtown, you'll have a variety of restaurants and movie theaters right at your fingertips, ensuring endless entertainment options.  This well-maintained high-rise building features the security and convenience of a doorman, ensuring peace of mind and a welcoming atmosphere. Stay active and healthy with access to an on-site gym and relax in the building's sauna after a long day.  Additional amenities include: - two indoor parking space  - Convenient laundry room and trash room located in the hallway: Rent includes heat, hot water, and cooking gas.
